notes.title: Mega Map and Wallpaper Mode Improvement Update Announcement
notes.notes:
【Map System Update】

    The mega map feature is now available! Map area has been expanded to 4 times larger, with the number of map cells doubled. Players can adjust the scale in "Map Editor -> Edit Height -> Map Scale".
    Added more map templates, which can generate more realistic world maps in conjunction with the mega map feature.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133465/cefe53ca5e2744c0b205ecfb3da1ddcfd0551688.png

【Wallpaper Mode Optimization】

    Added map interaction functionality, supporting click operations
    Added multi-screen support, allowing free selection of display screens
    Added two modes: non-interactive/interactive
    
        
            Non-interactive mode supports low frame rate settings, effectively reducing device heat
            Modes can be quickly switched via system tray
        
    
    Fixed issues where wallpaper mode would become ineffective in certain situations

【Performance Optimization】

    Optimized province border update performance
    Optimized coastline update mechanism, implementing delayed updates for border lines when editing height maps
    Fixed excessive drawcalls in height map background

【Visual Effects】

    Added emergency mobilization army scaling animation

【Bug Fixes】

    Fixed map freezing issues when placing provinces in certain situations
    Fixed map rendering errors after changing map scale
    Fixed Korean text display encoding issues in certain situations

notes.title: Editor Improvements Update Notes - January 16
notes.notes:
I. Editor Logic Improvements            When switching to different editing options, the corresponding view will now automatically switch without needing to adjust administrative map transparency or background map type in map appearance settings. After closing the editing panel, the map will revert to display according to map appearance settings.        II. Province Editing Features Update            Added a regenerate province button and average province cell count option in the province editing panel. You can adjust province generation density by modifying the average number of cells per province.        III. Interface Tooltip Improvements            Added numerous editor-related tooltips. Hover your mouse over buttons to see their usage instructions.        IV. New Map Editing Tutorial    
1. Map Mechanics: Based on Voronoi diagrams, each province consists of multiple adjacent polygons (cells). A province is the smallest unit that a country can occupy. Therefore, provinces need to be edited before countries.
    
2. Editing Sequence:
            Open the global command panel and disable autonomous diplomacy and rebellion to prevent countries from attacking each other or engaging in diplomatic actions and rebellions.        Generate a height map, which can be edited using the brush tool.        Generate a biome map based on the height map, which can be edited using the brush tool. You can also adjust ecological parameters to automatically generate biomes.        Generate a province map based on the biome map, which can be edited using the brush tool.        Generate a country map based on the province map, or place countries to occupy each province.        Enable autonomous diplomacy and rebellion to start the game.        
3. To modify country attributes such as religion or government type, left-click on the corresponding country on the map to open the country information panel for editing.
    
4. To change province names or categories, shift + left-click on the corresponding province on the map to open the province information panel for editing.
    V. Multilingual Support Optimization            Fixed Chinese character display issues for Latin-based languages and Korean. Maps with Chinese and Japanese text downloaded from the Workshop will now display correctly without showing squares. Built-in translation features will be added in the future to facilitate map sharing among players of different languages.        VI. Performance Optimization            Fixed lag issues caused by excessive alliances in certain situations.        VII. Bug Fixes and Feature Updates            Fixed an issue where regenerating ecology would clear rivers and prevent refreshing the ecology map.        Added a new global command option: toggle generation of unconquerable regions in tundra and desert. You can disable this option if you don't want these region types to generate.

notes.title: Vassal States, Economy & Combat Power, Fortress System Update
notes.notes:
Vassal State System    Nations may become vassals after defeat in war    Vassals must pay annual tribute (30% of yearly income) to their overlord in December    Overlords have military access to vassal territories    Vassals are forced to leave all alliances and end all wars    Diplomatic Restrictions:        [olist]            Vassals have no independent diplomatic power            Must follow all decisions made by their overlord        [/olist]        Independence Mechanics:        [olist]            No independence seeking within first 5 years of vassalization            More likely to seek independence when power grows close to overlord            More likely during overlord's military setbacks            More likely when overlord corruption is high            Desire for independence increases with time        [/olist]        Interface Improvements:        [olist]            New vassal controls added to nation panel            Vassal borders shown in green            Overlord borders shown in purple        [/olist]    Provincial Fortress System    Added manual fortress/pass editing functionality    Operation: Hold Shift + Left Click to open province panel    Option to fortify or de-fortify provincial capitalsTreasury Impact on Combat Power    Treasury status now affects national combat power    Government Type Effects:        [olist]            Tribal systems least affected by treasury            Imperial systems moderately affected            Republican systems most affected        [/olist]        Cultural Effects:        [olist]            Nomadic cultures least dependent on treasury            Hunter-gatherer and agricultural cultures moderately dependent            Maritime cultures more dependent            Commercial cultures most dependent on treasury status        [/olist]    
Note: Vassal independence probability is dynamically adjusted based on relative power comparison with the overlord.

notes.title: Update - November 27 Unconquerable Regions and More map icons
notes.notes:
Unconquerable Regions

    Added three new types of unconquerable territories:
        ・Gobi
        ・Desert
        ・Tundra
    New visible markers appear after map generation
    Added environmental indicators:
        ・Cactus icons for desert regions
        ・Mountain/Highland icons for elevated terrain


Map Editor Enhancements

    New features in Map Editor -> Edit Ecology:
        ・Draw unconquerable regions
        ・Access region management panel
    Region customization options:
        ・Color adjustment
        ・Name modification


Interface Updates

    Extended nation information panel:
        ・Added more detailed national statistics
        ・Enhanced information display


Terrain Editing Improvements

    New height modification features:
        ・Modify terrain height in existing nations' territories
        ・Unified red-yellow-white color scheme for height editing
    Enhanced nation regeneration:
        ・Preserves manual province distributions
        ・Maintains custom province names

        ・Edit ecological features before nation generation
        ・Preserve custom ecology when generating nations


System Improvements

We will be working on updates for puppet states, alliances, religions, cultural map displays, and doubling the current number of tiles.

notes.title: November 8th Update: River System Features
notes.notes:
New Features

River System

    Added river drawing feature in Map Editor -> Edit Ecology -> Draw Rivers
    Controls:
        ・Left-click to select and edit rivers
        ・SHIFT + Left-click to create new rivers
        ・ALT + Left-click to add control points
        ・DELETE to remove selected rivers


War Statistics

    Added casualties and elimination statistics
    Available data:
        ・View battle losses for both sides in Nation Panel
        ・Access detailed war statistics in Statistics Panel


Nation Placement

    Adjusted nation placement mechanism on height maps:
        ・New nations now start with a single province
        ・No longer occupies the entire map by default
        ・Nations gradually expand from their initial province


System Improvements

    Enhanced army AI decision-making:
        ・Fixed armies getting stuck in loops when defending against island nation invasions
        ・Improved military operation efficiency
    Fixed invalid burg names appearing during province editing
    Fixed save files failing to load due to time overflow issues


Recent updates have focused on improving the map editor functionality. If you encounter any issues while using the software, please don't hesitate to contact us with your feedback. Editor-related features will be near completion by November, and from December onwards, we will begin updating game simulation content.

notes.title: Grayscale Map Import Now Available - October 26, 2024 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Grayscale Map Import

    The grayscale map import feature can be found in Map Editor -> Edit Height
    Height corresponding rules:
                    ・Darker colors (closer to black) -> Lower elevation
                    ・Lighter colors (closer to white) -> Higher elevation
    
    Ocean threshold can be set (1-255)
                    ・Areas below the set threshold will be generated as ocean
    
    Supports importing height maps created by third-party websites or software


Other Additions

    Added confirmation popup for refreshing rivers and shipping routes


Performance Optimization

    Improved pathfinding performance for armies
                    ・Reduced lag when starting the game
                    ・Reduced lag when nations are destroyed
    
    Optimized province drawing performance
    Fixed game crashes caused by memory overflow when drawing provinces and biomes


Recent updates continue to focus on the editor. Game simulation-related logic will begin to be updated after features like river drawing are completed. If you encounter any issues during use, please contact us with your feedback promptly.

notes.title: Fantasy Map Simulator EA Release Note !
notes.notes: Official Version Update Log:            The Workshop is now open, allowing uploads of maps, custom religions, and culture sets. National attributes, specialties, and localization files can be edited and tested locally. Please remember to back up your files, as game updates may delete your custom mods.        Added volume control functionality, allowing players to adjust the volume.        Added current campaign information for provinces, allowing players to view the progress of provincial campaigns.        Added more documentation.        Removed the 700-year game time limit. Theoretically, game time is now unlimited, but extremely long game times (tens of thousands of years) may result in large save files (due to the historical backtracking feature), leading to longer save and load times.        Fixed some localization issues across various languages.        Added army camera follow functionality.        Added random appearance display and 8 map appearance templates for players to choose from.        Added a national editing panel, allowing editing of national attributes, government systems, religions, and ethnic attributes.        Added in-game plans for future updates, please check for details.        AI has undergone some overall adjustments. The main mechanisms of the latest game are explained as follows:    [olist]        Corruption Mechanism                            After a nation is established, corruption values gradually increase over time                The accumulation speed of corruption is affected by the following factors:                                            Population: When the population is too high (falling into the Malthusian trap), corruption accumulates faster                        Economy: When the treasury is in deficit, corruption accumulates faster                                                    When corruption is too high, it will trigger a potential background reform event (currently without event text), which will reset the corruption value                            Population System                            Provincial population cap is based on the current biome                Population growth rate is affected by ethnic attributes                War leads to population decline                Low population reduces the willingness to initiate wars                Population size determines troop replenishment rate                            Economy and Specialty System                            Provincial resources are determined by the biome                Economic output is affected by ethnic attributes and national government system                Military expenses depend on troop mobilization                Administrative efficiency is determined by the size of the territory                Taxation is based on population and specialties                War reduces the economic output of the affected province to zero                Corruption affects tax efficiency                Treasury deficit reduces the willingness to initiate wars                            Core Area                            Centered around the capital, expands over time                Emergency mobilization when threatened                Mobilization scale is affected by corruption level and economic status                Leaves national ethnic imprints, deeper with longer time                Clears the ethnic imprints of extinct nations                            Rebellion and Nation Restoration System                            The farther from the core area, the higher the probability of rebellion                Remote areas are prone to rebellion during high corruption                Rebellion may lead to the restoration of old nations in that province                Even core areas may rebel under extreme corruption                            Combat System                            Army combat effectiveness is affected by terrain, economy, corruption level, and national characteristics                Interior operations (core area) have easy supply lines and lower military expenses                Expeditions or overseas operations are costly, with high military expenses                Surrounded or semi-surrounded troops are in a "salient", with halved combat effectiveness                Island nation strategy: May conduct frequent harassing attacks against continental nations                                            May cause continental nations' armies to be constantly on the move                                                    Only maritime and commercial ethnicities or very powerful nations will conduct distant overseas operations                Armies will prioritize deployment at borders                Armies are divided into potential garrison troops, guard troops, and field troops                                            Field armies prioritize attacking foreign territories                        Guard troops prioritize suppressing rebellions                        Garrison troops prioritize stationing                                                    When the capital is threatened (nearby provinces are attacked), the national army's troop efficiency will increase by one level, and some garrison troops will change their identity                Fortresses: Will build fortresses or checkpoints in mountainous areas, which are difficult to conquer                            Diplomatic System            Basic Relations Special ability: Strong religious propagation ability, may influence other nations                        National Strength and Diplomatic Attitude            [olist]                Great Power
